card.name: Inside long ALL-CAPS warning words
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long words written in ALL CAPS, mostly in boxed warnings and precaution headings, such as STAB-IL-IZED, HYPERSENS-IT-IVITY and BRON-CH-OSPASTIC.

modes.label: Hypersensitivity and bronchospastic
modes.description: Middle pieces of the capitalised words HYPERSENSITIVITY and BRONCHOSPASTIC in warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: ANAPHYLAXIS AND OTHER SERIOUS HYPERSENS<<IT>>IVITY REACTIONS Serious hypersensitivity reactions

modes.label: Other capitalised verbs
modes.description: Early pieces of capitalised verbs like OCCURRED, OCCURS, STABILIZED and EMPHASIZED in warning sentences.
modes.example: IT SHOULD BE EMP<<HAS>>IZED THAT DOSAGE REQUIREMENTS ARE VARIABLE

card.writes: It helps the model finish the rest of a long capitalised word, though the listed tokens show no clear pattern.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long words printed in capital letters in label warnings.
